name: activity.md
summary: Activity: incremental read of ACCESS_HISTORY, UTC hours map and business-time offset, the Activity tab numbers per object / user / role / app / scope / warehouse, query_sql, grant path behind a use, rules 24-28, Streamlit app exposure (29)

name: Rule 24: Person changed data or a table's definition
summary: Medium. A person (in USER, not a service user) ran WRITE or DDL on a known object with a role that has no OWNERSHIP reach on it (data_use(role)[1][object] lacks "own"); one finding per user and object: statement counts, the most used role, last day. access.py:5499-5509

name: Rule 25: Service user used from an interactive client
summary: High. A service user (is_service) has activity rows whose CLIENT is in INTERACTIVE (Snowflake UI, SnowSQL, Snowflake CLI); one finding per service user: queries per client label, tables, last day. access.py:5494-5495,5192-5198

name: Rule 26: Admin role used to read or change data
summary: High. Activity rows whose ROLE_NAME is in ADMIN on a known object; one finding per user and admin role: objects read, objects changed (action not READ), first three names. access.py:5496-5497,5199-5203

name: Rule 27: First access to a table in the last 7 days
summary: Low. Per user and object: the first day on the object is within the last NEW_DAYS (7) days of the snapshot and the user had activity before cut - NEW_DAYS (not a new user); detail adds "sensitive" for tagged objects. access.py:5488,5179-5183

name: Rule 28: Unusual volume on a table
summary: Medium. Per user and object with at least 5 active days: the busiest day has >= SPIKE[1] (50) queries and more than SPIKE[0] (3) x the median day. access.py:5515-5522

name: Activity read window (incremental)
summary: Window = ACTIVITY_DAYS (60) back from now; rows of an earlier read are kept up to the day before its last day, and that day onwards is read again (ACCESS_HISTORY lags up to 3 hours). Same in SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT activity() (sql/1_setup.sql:586-594).

name: App's own queries left out of activity
summary: The app's connection sets QUERY_TAG 'access-explorer' (sf.py:34); activity_sql drops QUERY_HISTORY rows with that tag (access.py:968, sql/1_setup.sql:567).

name: Activity tab counts
summary: activity(name, what, user): queries per day over ACTIVITY_DAYS ending at the snapshot day for an object, user, role, app (APP) or scope (OBJECT_NAME under name + '.'), totals by user/role/client/statement/object split into read/write/ddl, one row per user+role+client+object+statement+action with hours per UTC hour (weekdays), weekend and weekend_hours, first_day, kind and interactive; counts are per action, so a MERGE that reads and changes a table counts twice.

name: Grant path behind a use
summary: used_path(user, role, object, action): user -> shortest chain to the role used -> shortest data_use chain to a holder of a privilege that fits the action (READ_PRIVS for READ, else WRITE_PRIVS or OWNERSHIP) -> object; None when the role reaches no such grant now (admin role, grant gone).

name: ACTIVITY_DAYS
summary: Days of table activity read and shown (env ACTIVITY_DAYS, default 60)

name: QUERY_TAG
summary: Query tag of the app's own connection, 'access-explorer'

name: INTERACTIVE
summary: Clients where people type queries (env INTERACTIVE_CLIENTS; default Snowflake UI, SnowSQL, Snowflake CLI); rule 25

name: CLIENTS
summary: SESSIONS client id (version cut) -> short label (Snowflake UI -> Snowsight, PythonConnector -> Python, ...)

name: SPIKE
summary: Rule 28 thresholds: (3 x the median day, at least 50 queries)

name: NEW_DAYS
summary: Rule 27: first access within the last 7 days

name: MAX_ACTIVITY
summary: Activity rows sent (2000); the counts above them cover all rows

name: Rule 29: Streamlit app shows its owner's sensitive data to people who cannot read it
summary: High. Per Streamlit app (kinds STREAMLIT) whose owner roles (OWNERSHIP) read sensitive objects, per role holding USAGE on the app: users reaching that role who cannot read some of those objects through their own roles (user_reads) -> one finding on the holder role: app, owner, sensitive objects, users. Fix: revoke the app's USAGE from the role. access.py:4662-4677, app_exposure access.py:4622-4635

name: Streamlit app runs with its owner's rights
summary: app_exposure(app): owner = roles with OWNERSHIP on the app; sensitive = what the owner reads that is sensitive (columns, [] = whole object); holders = roles with USAGE on the app -> users reaching them; exposed = per user the sensitive objects they cannot read through their own roles (PUBLIC included); None without an owner

name: Activity hours in UTC, business time as an offset
summary: activity_sql groups per UTC day and keeps HOURS = {UTC hour: queries} (access.py:951-952, 970-975); activity() splits them into weekday hours and weekend_hours (access.py:4328-4333); the UI counts off-hours as weekend queries plus weekday hours outside [start, end) after shifting by a UTC offset (offOf, web/src/pages/Activity.tsx:25-26); default start-end from WORK_HOURS 7-19 (access.py:70, server.py:1674)

name: Activity view by object type
summary: activity_page picks the view from the object's kind: STREAMLIT -> app (rows where APP = name), DATABASE / SCHEMA -> scope (every object under the name), WAREHOUSE -> who ran queries on it from the usage read (warehouse_use, no ACCESS_HISTORY), else object; app and scope get no grant-path graph

name: Copy-only SQL behind the Activity tab
summary: query_sql(name, what, first, last): read-only SELECT over ACCESS_HISTORY x QUERY_HISTORY x SESSIONS listing every query id, time, user, role, statement, object and client in the window (no query text), filter per what (object, user, role, app by StreamlitName, scope by LIKE prefix), quotes doubled; the app never runs it

name: WORK_HOURS
summary: Business hours start-end (env WORK_HOURS, default 7-19, end exclusive); sent as work to the Activity tab, which shifts them from UTC with its business-time slider

name: Which SQL a page shows to run yourself
summary: Per page and params, the read-only ACCOUNT_USAGE queries behind it with SET lines filled in (grants from access_queries files, activity per section, tags, policies, PUBLIC, admin holders, dormant users); the app never runs them. See logic/page-sql.md.

name: SQL behind each Activity section
summary: One query per Activity section over ACCESS_HISTORY x QUERY_HISTORY x SESSIONS for the name and window, default business hours, TZ_HOURS=0; sent as section_sql. See logic/page-sql.md.
